jia: hi team, jia here, day 1 on runtime. I followed the BUILD.md and built on dl-build-07 (ubuntu22.04) but unit `gpu_op_tests` crashes on launch with 
`CUDA driver error: invalid configuration argument`. Any on-call infra folks?
jia: exact build command: `CC=gcc-11 CXX=g++-11 cmake -S. -Bbuild -DREDWOOD_USE_CUDA=ON -DCUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=/usr/local/cuda-12` then `cmake --build build -j12` and `build/bin/gpu_op_tests`
jia: quick ldd shows mixed paths: libcudnn.so.8 -> /opt/cudnn/8.4/lib64, libcuda.so.1 -> /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1
leo: welcome jia! :wave: this usually means PTX vs driver mismatch or an sm_arch mismatch. Can you run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,name --format=csv` and paste output? Also `env | grep LD_LIBRARY_PATH`
infra-bot: Note: dl-build-07 had a driver rollback yesterday for kernel compat. See INFRA-821.
jia: nvidia-smi output: driver_version, name
450.119.03, NVIDIA A40
jia: LD_LIBRARY_PATH is unset inside the build container; we mount host /usr/lib which has libcuda 450 and container CUDA is 12 -> mismatch.
leo: yep that explains it. Newer CUDA 12 toolkits generate PTX/versions that older driver 450 can't JIT. Short-term: set `-DCUDA_NVCC_FLAGS="-gencode=arch=compute_70,code=sm_70"` to compile older codegen or use our compat image `redwood/dev-runtime:cuda11.8-gcc11`. Longer-term infra should update drivers to 520+.
kai: filing infra ticket INFRA-830 to coordinate driver update on dl-build-07. If you need a quick repro VM with 525, ping me.
jia: thanks, lowered arch to sm_70 and tests now run. I'll open a PR to document recommended images for onboarding. Appreciate the help! :tada:
